idea-plugin.name: Duck Progress Bar
idea-plugin.description:
Replaces the default IDE progress bar with a swimming rubber duck.
  • Indeterminate progress: the duck paddles back and forth, turning around at the edges.
  • Determinate progress: the duck swims at the end of the filled part of the bar.
  • Three vector characters: duck, vampire duck and a rolling Jack-o'-lantern, plus the classic PNG duck.
  • Optional trail behind the duck: bubbles or wave, for indeterminate bars and optionally for determinate ones.
  • Character and trail are configured in Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Duck Progress Bar.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.0.0
  • New settings page: enable or disable, character and trail.
  • New vector characters: duck, vampire duck and Jack-o'-lantern. The classic PNG duck is still available.
  • New trails behind the duck: bubbles and wave.
  • The duck is no longer clipped by the bar and stops before the right edge.
  • Support for current IDE versions (2024.3 and newer).
  • Duck speed no longer depends on the repaint rate.
  • The progress bar is applied on IDE startup, not only after a theme change.
